clue.text: Questioned the thing done, with brusque interrupting

indicators.note: brusque breaks into the middle of the thing done, so one word sits inside the other

parts.note: a deed is a thing done
brief can mean curt or brusque in manner

explanation.surface: Someone was quizzed curtly about a completed job, with a rude interruption.
explanation.definitionFit: To debrief someone is to question them after a mission, so the past tense means questioned.

clue.text: Nobody wrote one in the nineteenth century

definitions.text: Nobody wrote one in the nineteenth century

parts.words: Nobody wrote one in the nineteenth century
parts.note: the Grossmiths' 1892 comic novel records the daily life of Charles Pooter, its title calling him a Nobody

explanation.surface: An apparent claim that no one kept a journal in the 1800s.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nobody' is a capitalised character: The Diary of a Nobody is a classic English comic novel of the 1890s.
explanation.definitionFit: Pooter's daily journal is a book of dated personal entries.

clue.text: Rose as a reactionary in America

definitions.meaning: a class of old garden roses bears the name of the French royal house
in US politics the name was given to an ultraconservative Democrat

explanation.surface: A US conservative who rose to prominence as a reactionary.
explanation.definitionFit: Both the rose variety and the political label take the name of the French royal dynasty, a byword for refusing change.

clue.text: Like word very hard to clue one put in "banned" file originally

definitions.text: Like word very hard to clue

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: the letters are set out in a new, original way

explanation.surface: A setter puts an impossible word into a file of rejected ideas.
explanation.definitionFit: A word that is very hard to clue is one you cannot readily define.

clue.text: Much beer less than completely admirable — get upset inside

indicators.note: the annoyance word goes within the shortened word
the word for admirable is shortened, losing its final letter

parts.note: fine means admirable
to irk is to get at someone and upset them

explanation.surface: Plenty of beer, short of perfect, makes someone grumpy.
explanation.definitionFit: A firkin is a small cask, a quarter barrel, holding a fair quantity of beer.

clue.text: Nice English will keep rules and regulations in US location

indicators.note: the outer pieces hold the rules within them

parts.note: dear means nice or lovely
law is the body of rules

explanation.surface: An Englishman in Nice must still obey the rules while visiting America.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nice' looks like the French city but is simply an adjective here.
explanation.definitionFit: Delaware is a US state on the eastern seaboard.

clue.text: Profess intention to oust idiot from class

indicators.note: the intention pushes the idiot out of class and takes its place there

parts.note: an ass is a fool or idiot
an aim is an intention

explanation.surface: A teacher declares an intention to remove a fool from the classroom.
explanation.definitionFit: To claim something is to profess or assert it.

clue.text: One directing eight or ten joining firm

indicators.note: ten attaches to the end of the firm

parts.note: Co is the abbreviation for company, a firm
X is the Roman numeral ten

explanation.surface: Someone running a team of eight or ten people joins a company.
explanation.definitionFit: The cox steers a rowing eight and calls the stroke.

clue.text: Everyone gets to eat salmon and drink at celebration?

indicators.note: everyone takes the salmon inside, as if eating it

parts.note: all means everyone
coho is a Pacific salmon

explanation.surface: Guests at a party all tuck into salmon and have a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Alcohol is the intoxicating drink typically served at a party.

clue.text: Assistant in a fascist party cleared in a month

indicators.note: the pieces are placed within the month

parts.note: May is a month
NF is the National Front, a British far-right party
rid means cleared of something

explanation.surface: A helper in an extremist party is purged during a single month.
explanation.definitionFit: Robinson Crusoe's servant gave his name to any loyal personal assistant.

clue.text: Apart, ut infra

parts.note: Latin ut means as
Latin infra means below or under

explanation.surface: A scholarly cross-reference: 'apart, see below', in the Latin of footnotes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ut infra' is the footnote formula 'as below'; translated word by word it gives AS UNDER.
explanation.definitionFit: Torn asunder means torn apart, into separate pieces.

clue.text: Classical law: I study a range of terminology

parts.note: lex is the Latin, so classical, word for law
to con is to study or learn by heart

explanation.surface: A student of Roman law takes up its vocabulary.
explanation.definitionFit: A lexicon is the full vocabulary of a subject, its stock of terms.

clue.text: Troublemaker, unknown quantity, one no longer at school

parts.note: in algebra y stands for an unknown
OB is old boy, a former pupil

explanation.surface: A disruptive former pupil is something of a mystery.
explanation.definitionFit: A yob is British slang for a loutish young troublemaker.

clue.text: After war he and I sadly not the best of friends?

indicators.note: sadly suggests things going wrong, so the letters are put in disorder

explanation.surface: Two people who were close before the war have drifted apart since.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase is used of friends who desert you when times are hard, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Fair-weather friends stay only while things go well, so they are hardly the most loyal companions.

clue.text: Communicates a rustic tale animatedly

indicators.note: lively motion suggests the letters are jumbled into another order

explanation.surface: A storyteller vividly relates a country yarn.
explanation.definitionFit: To articulate ideas is to express them clearly, to communicate them.

clue.text: Stick around at home, like a sort of pet?

indicators.note: the stick goes around the words at home, enclosing them

parts.note: a cane is a walking stick
in means at home

explanation.surface: Stay in, lazing about the house, like a pampered pet.
explanation.definitionFit: Canine means relating to dogs, the commonest kind of household pet.

clue.text: Exercise in gym that could make Walter ache, losing head

indicators.note: the letters could be rearranged to make something new
the word ache loses its first letter

explanation.surface: A gymnastics move that might leave poor Walter aching.
explanation.definitionFit: A cartwheel is a sideways handspring done as a gymnastic exercise.

clue.text: President getting perturbed spoke incoherently

parts.note: rattled means unsettled or perturbed

explanation.surface: A flustered president rambled through a speech.
explanation.definitionFit: To prattle is to babble foolishly, talking without much sense.

clue.text: Struggled to hold note: a chant ultimately spoiled

indicators.note: struggled contains the following pieces

parts.note: vied means competed or struggled
ti is a note of the sol-fa scale

indicators.note: the final letter of chant is taken

explanation.surface: Singers strain to sustain a note and the chant ends up ruined.
explanation.definitionFit: To vitiate is to impair or spoil, so vitiated means spoiled.

clue.text: Country inn, outside which is an historical object

indicators.note: the historical object sits around the inn, enclosing it

parts.note: a relic is an object surviving from the past
a pub is an inn

explanation.surface: A country pub has an ancient artefact displayed outside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A republic is a state without a monarch, one kind of country.

clue.text: City break with awful smell around, not good

indicators.note: the shortened smell goes around the break
the abbreviation for good is left out

parts.note: pong is British slang for a stink
a rest is a break

explanation.surface: A city break spoiled by a horrible stench everywhere.
explanation.definitionFit: Preston is a city in Lancashire, northern England.

clue.text: Second Indian dish may make one run!

parts.note: a curry is a spiced Indian dish

explanation.surface: A second helping of a spicy dish might send you dashing to the loo.
explanation.definitionFit: To scurry is to run hurriedly with short steps.

clue.text: On street this person's becoming rebellious

parts.note: re means on, concerning
this person is the setter, I, so this person has is I've

explanation.surface: Living on the street, the speaker turns rebel.
explanation.definitionFit: Restive means restless and hard to control, so unruly or rebellious.

clue.text: Affection half veiled in phoney greeting

indicators.note: the half word is covered by the phoney, placed within it

parts.note: sham means fake or phoney

indicators.note: only the first half of the word for affection is used

parts.note: love is affection

explanation.surface: A half-hidden fondness lurking in an insincere hello.
explanation.definitionFit: Shalom is the Hebrew greeting meaning peace.

clue.text: Question from gangster's follower about destination, making ready?

parts.note: where is a question word, here one asking about destination
with Al, that is someone accompanying Al Capone, the gangster

explanation.surface: A henchman asks his boss where they are heading as they get ready.
explanation.walkthrough: The question is 'Where, with Al?', asked about destination by a follower of Al Capone. 'Ready' is slang for cash, which the answer supplies.
explanation.definitionFit: Wherewithal means the money or means needed, and the ready is slang for available cash.

clue.text: Like some wine from these cellars

indicators.note: the letters are taken out of the run of words these cellars

explanation.surface: A bottle of wine fetched up from these cellars.
explanation.definitionFit: Sec is French for dry, the description on some wines.

clue.text: Story of competition with someone really good knocked out

indicators.note: the good person is removed from the competition

parts.note: a contest is a competition
St is saint, a very good person

explanation.surface: A tale of a contest in which a star competitor is eliminated.
explanation.definitionFit: A conte is a short story, especially in French literature.

clue.text: Selection of words in pamphlet once

indicators.note: the former-status prefix goes in front of the pamphlet

parts.note: ex means former, once
a tract is a short pamphlet

explanation.surface: A quotation taken from what was once a pamphlet.
explanation.definitionFit: An extract is a passage chosen from a longer text.

clue.text: Vehicle, about to get submerged in part of turning circle?

indicators.note: in a down light the letter sinks to the bottom of the word

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
c is circa, about

explanation.surface: A car is about to sink while turning in a circle.
explanation.definitionFit: An arc is a section of the circumference of a circle.

clue.text: European fixer about to accommodate a set

indicators.note: the turned fixer houses the following pieces within it
the fixer is turned about, read backwards

parts.note: a nail fixes things together
a TV set

explanation.surface: A repairman from Europe is about to install a television.
explanation.definitionFit: A Latvian is a native of Latvia, a country in Europe.

clue.text: There's nothing about sort of current needed for nuclear research device

indicators.note: the word for nothing is turned about, read backwards

parts.note: nil means nothing
AC is alternating current

explanation.surface: A physics lab apparatus needs no particular electrical supply.
explanation.definitionFit: A linac, short for linear accelerator, speeds up particles for nuclear physics experiments.

clue.text: Syrian in a location behind barrier

indicators.note: the other pieces come after the barrier

parts.note: a dam is a barrier across water
a scene is the place where something happens

explanation.surface: Someone from Syria standing at a spot behind a wall.
explanation.definitionFit: Damascene means of Damascus, the Syrian capital.
